latest_release.name: AERS v2026.07 — first tagged release
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- **First tagged release.** Every gate is green: `make check` (validate + 183 unit tests + eval-harness + numeric benchmarks), validate-catalog, quality-evals, and OpenSSF Scorecard on `main`.
- **Rigor double loop at 13 method families.** Each family closes taxonomy tag → eval scenario (does the agent avoid the method's known traps?) → deterministic numeric benchmark (does it recover the true effect?). New this cycle: heterogeneous treatment effects (CATE) and quantile treatment effects (QTE).
- **Paper-WorkFlow flagship at 29/29 executable rigor gates**, now merged to its `main` with a drift-gated README badge — the credibility artifact is checked by CI, so it can never silently go stale ([RIGOR.md](https://github.com/brycewang-stanford/Paper-WorkFlow/blob/main/RIGOR.md)).
- **1,150 vendored skills / 69 collections**, all license-audited, security-scanned, tracked in a machine-readable catalog with CI-enforced freshness, and importable as a single whole-repo router skill.
- **Hardened weekly upstream syncs**: synced trees must pass the full gate before merge; this cycle both sync PRs were verified, patched (StatsPAI's SkillOpt execution-gate card restored), and merged.
- **First-party plugin marketplace** (Python / R / Stata empirical-analysis plugins + guide) shipped in the previous cycle, now under a tagged version.

## Known Follow-Ups

- Ecosystem benchmark comparison (AERS vs econometrics agents on the shared benchmark suite) — [PLAN-2026-07 week 3](https://github.com/brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills/blob/main/docs/PLAN-2026-07.md).
- Decomposition (Oaxaca–Blinder) and shift-share (Bartik) method families (weeks 3–4).
- GitHub Pages catalog site, README demo screenshots, five-language README consistency script (week 4).

## Catalog

- Top-level collections: **69**
- `SKILL.md` files: **1150**
- Cataloged agent tools: **335** ([`tools/CATALOG.md`](../tools/CATALOG.md))

## Methodological rigor

- Method families in the coverage map: **13** ([`RIGOR_COVERAGE.md`](RIGOR_COVERAGE.md))
- Eval scenarios: **26** (138 rubric items, 122 auto-checkable) ([`../eval-harness/`](../eval-harness/README.md))
- Benchmark tasks: **13** (70 gold checks, 58 required) ([`../benchmark/`](../benchmark/README.md))

## Quality gates

- `make check` — catalog/provenance/audit/eval freshness, repo hygiene,
  Paper-WorkFlow gates, stdlib unit tests, eval-harness lint + graded smoke,
  and the strict numeric benchmark (reference-gold drift fails the build).
- External links and OpenSSF Scorecard run on their scheduled workflows.
